message: 消滅

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... ugh...」
The first thing I felt was the wind.
A wind fierce enough to slice everything to shreds.
The howling roar of the gale rushing past my ears.
The next thing I felt was the heat.
A heat fierce enough to burn everything to ash.
The wind, the air, the ground--everything was scorching.
It felt like I was lying on top of a sizzling frying pan.
Yet, it didn't feel like I was getting burned.
Ah, right, I'm in my Demon Lord form.
I must have transformed instinctively to guard against the impact battering my whole body.
I felt strangely calm, and it was eerie.
What happened?
I confessed to Azel, and then--

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
A god stood there.
Assuming, that is, a god is something that brings overwhelming terror and despair.
It towered against a backdrop of seven-colored meteors cascading down like a mad avalanche.
I knew that god's name.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
The god looked at me.
A gaze devoid of all emotion, merely taking stock of my presence.
The sensation of an icy blade piercing straight through my chest.
Even so, I took a step forward and strained with everything I had to force my voice out.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You mustn't go near her!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Melilot
message: 「She is Re-Crea! Azel-san isn't anywhere inside her anymore!」

name: Synn
message: 「Re-Crea...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The Demon Lord's fated enemy.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is going on?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Over there!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-Azel...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's... Azel-san, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's Azel! Who else could she possibly be!」
Like hell she's some god!
That girl is the one I love more than anyone else in the world!

name: Misa
message: 「B-But...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「E-Eek! There's some crazy dangerous presence!」

name: Synn
message: 「...!? Oh no, scatter!」
Azel's fingertips twitched slightly.
The night sky lit up like broad daylight.

name: Everyone
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaa!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaaaaah!」
I avoided a direct hit, but the shockwave of the explosion lifted my body off the ground.
Hearing the wind slicing past my ears, I'm blown away!
I hit the back of my head on something and nearly black out for a second.

name: Synn
message: 「Where's Azel!? Where's everyone!?」
The power is so overwhelming that even a Demon Lord's spatial perception is shaken, making it impossible to tell clearly.
It isn't killing intent. A will colder than that--one best described as elimination--pierces right through me.
Instinctively, I kick off the ground.
I somehow avoided a direct hit, yet the shockwave of the explosion lifted my body into the air once again.
Hearing the wind slicing past my ears, I'm blown away!

name: Synn
message: 「Ukuuaah.」
This time, my head slammed into something hard.
Did the back of my head split open? It feels wet and hot.
Looking up behind me, I see a church. It's the church wall.
What do I do!?
Even if I try to fight back, there's no way I can attack Azel.
But at this rate, everyone is....

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, are you okay!? Whoa, so much blood!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm fine...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're not fine at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Azel! Are you trying to kill Synn!?」
Azel was staring straight at me.
Here it comes!

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka... run...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell I can run!」
Nanaka stands firmly with her feet planted wide, shielding me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't give me that bullshit about loving him enough to kill him, you bastard!」
The ominous aura of light about to be unleashed receded.
I felt a faint flicker of emotion light up in her cold eyes.

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's a limit to how forgetful you can be!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's right. You were just about to kill Synn!」
An emotion akin to fear glinted in Azel's eyes.

name: Azel
message: 「A-Aah! A...aah, I was about to do that to Synn again!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel! Do you recognize me?! It's me! You know who I am, right?!」
Suddenly, all emotion vanished from her eyes.

name: Azel
message: 「Demon Lord.」
Azel pointed her fingertips toward us and twitched them slightly.

name: Azel
message: 「Aah. Stop, stop it, right now, at least not yet!」
I can't run!
If I run, Nanaka will be killed!
If I let Azel kill Nanaka, Azel will never be able to come back to us!
I have to stop it somehow.

name: Synn
message: 「Ooooooh!」
I thrust my right arm forward and picture a shield.
An invincible shield. A shield that can withstand any blow!
My arm screams in pain.
The shield I am desperately willing into existence is being scorched away even within my own mind.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun! Nanaka-chan!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun! Nanaka-san!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President! Ms. Treasurer!」

name: Synn
message: 「We're... alive?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's true...」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's the power of the Demon Lord for ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「The Demon Lord's... power?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It grows in proportion to Re-Crea getting stronger, and when the time comes, it'll get even stronger.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-Synn! Y-Your arm! Your arm!」
His right arm, which he had thrust forward, was dyed bright red.
It was swollen, with blood flowing from the joints.

name: Paqy
message: 「You blocked it, but... you didn't come out unscathed. If she'd fired them in rapid succession, you'd have been done for.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Loro-chan! Loro-chan! Synn is!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoa! It's a splatter! I'll heal you right now!」

name: Azel
message: 「A-Ah... no, no! I don't want this! At least not right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
Azel was shaking her head as if refusing.
She was frightened.

name: Azel
message: 「Ah... no good... no good... forgive me for now... forgive me...」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is bad!」
Once again, countless points of light began to float up.
As if reluctant, they lit up one after another.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel... she doesn't want to do this...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Someone! Attack Azel!」

name: Misa
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you saying!」

name: Ria
message: 「We can't attack Azel-chan!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda has lost his mind.」

name: Paqy
message: 「As if Re-Crea could be taken down by a single attack from the likes of you! Slap her to bring her back to her senses! Make her control it herself.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will do it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... what do you mean!?」
Melilot-san took out her cell phone.

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena. Coordinates: 3934.」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't tell me... *that*?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes. Right now.」

name: Helena
message: 「Understood.」
Suddenly, the lights in the academy building's windows went out.

name: Ria
message: 「A blackout?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is that?!」
Countless streaks of intense light shot up into the night sky from all across the academy.
The streaks of light intertwined, weaving together into a single colossal shape more than large enough to envelop the entire academy.
Standing straight and tall as if to shield us, Melilot began to chant in a resonant voice.

name: Melilot
message: 「O wind of the Human World that stirs the clouds, roils the waves, and mows down all!」
Once again, all emotion drained from Azel's eyes.
The points of light multiplied explosively.

name: Melilot
message: 「O lightning, flame, and heat that burn the Human World to ashes! O life that sets all within the Human World squirming!」
The outline of Melilot's body shimmered.

name: Synn
message: 「Magic power...」
And it even surpasses Professor Sengen'in's?!

name: Paqy
message: 「The Nive Clan, huh.」

name: Misa
message: 「Melilot is using magic... She's a Demon?!」

name: Ria
message: 「No way... Nobody told me about this.」
Azel's eyes turned toward us.
Eyes of absolute zero, completely devoid of emotion.

name: Melilot
message: 「O water that brings rain to the Human World and sweeps all away! O omnipresent power of the void, source of all these things! Bring silence and nothingness unto these fools!」
The back of Melilot's clothes was soaked with sweat.
Immense magic power overflowed, and a ferocious presence stirred.

name: Melilot
message: 「Ruin!」
The night screamed.
The instant the shape floating in the night sky vanished, a thick, viscous crimson light rained down!
It was blood wept by the night sky.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
As I instinctively started to stand up, Melilot grabbed my arm.
Her hand was slick with cold sweat.

name: Melilot
message: 「Please rest assured. An attack of that level would barely even erase a Bylous, let alone an opponent who serves as a vessel housing Re-Crea...」

name: Synn
message: 「Housing?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I doubt it even had the effect of swatting her away, as the Great Sage put it.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, it was the best card we had to play right now.」

name: Misa
message: 「Great Sage?」
Just as I thought I saw Melilot-san's body sway, she dropped to her knees.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you okay!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm... fine...」
The aftermath of the explosion begins to settle.
Our field of vision clears.
Azel was standing stock-still in the center of the plaza with a dazed expression.
From the looks of it, she didn't have a single scratch on her.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
Azel's neck moved sluggishly.
Looking at me.
Then she looked at her own fingers.

name: Azel
message: 「...I... Once again, I tried to... Synn...」
When she raised her face, it was as white as a sheet of paper.

name: Azel
message: 「I tried to kill Synn... and everyone...」
Staggering, she backed away.
I instinctively stood up and chased after her.
This time, Melilot-san didn't stop me either.

name: Synn
message: 「It's okay! Everyone's alive! You didn't do anything, Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「I tried to... Synn, everyone... These fingers pointed right at Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「You weren't trying to kill us, Azel! That wasn't you. That thing wasn't Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「...That's right... In the end, I am... nothing more than a weapon to be manipulated... just like he said...」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you talking about!」

name: Azel
message: 「If I'm just a weapon, I never needed a heart in the first place.」
Azel looked at me.

name: Azel
message: 「Attack me the very instant I appear again.」

name: Synn
message: 「What does... this mean...?」

name: Azel
message: 「Synn, thank you.」
Azel's smile was transparent.
As if she had given up on everything, there was nothing left on her face but a smile.

name: Azel
message: 「For telling me you loved me, even though I'm nothing more than my master's weapon.」
Azel's figure began to fade.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」

name: Azel
message: 「Goodbye.」
I thought my eyes were playing tricks on me. I wanted to think so.
Yet, my outstretched hand passed right through Azel's figure, which had grown so faint I could see straight through to the other side.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!! There's still something I haven't told you!」
I felt like I saw Azel's lips move.
But I couldn't tell what she said.

name: Synn
message: 「At the end of the Holy Night Festival, let's dance together--」
No one was there.
